routes.BTC: resolved_execution_asset=BTC; includes explicitly active BTC overlay
routes.BASE: resolved_execution_asset=Phase60 concrete holding for the same economic interval; weekly candidate is informational
routes.CANDIDATE: requires candidate_trigger_active=true; resolved_execution_asset=weekly chosen candidate and matches candidate return price symbol

identity_rule: Route, concrete price-return symbol, signal target, Production Core target, canonical execution intent and dashboard signal have one shared lineage. An inactive candidate never overrides BASE.
performance_rule: A target from closed data day D applies only at a price after signal_available_at. Historical ledger holdings are interval-start executed holdings and may differ from the newly available target; both carry their own signal lineage. model_index consumes only the causal net ledger, never legacy same-day return or account PnL.
availability_rule: Current availability is the actual completed computation timestamp after the newest closed UTC day. Historical unavailable build timestamps are explicit estimates, not invented observations.
dynamic_support_rule: Validate the concrete strategy result against same-symbol price data and current Hyperliquid market metadata. Candidate drop lists are candidate selection policy only and never rename a BASE output. No manual asset allowlist.
entry_failure_scope: Missing exchange support or liquidity for the new target blocks only that entry. Existing supported positions may still be reduced/closed. Scheduler and dashboard remain operational; original target and failure reason remain visible.
rotation_rule: Reduce-only exit of unwanted positions, fresh account read-back, fresh equity and size computation, then supported target entry. Never size entry using hypothetical exit proceeds as if a fill had occurred.
no_submit_rule: Run the whole canonical production pipeline with --no-submit. Refresh and read-only metadata/account calls are allowed. Order submission, cancellation, modification, leverage mutation and live reconciliation are forbidden. A post-exit entry is a conditional preview, not a fill or fabricated account read-back.
deployment_scope: Code staged on Pi for no-submit verification only; preserve current production data, secrets, journal, position and scheduler configuration. No merge to main and no automatic activation of the candidate code.
separate_future_issue: Do not add stop-loss or trailing-stop features. Existing reduce-only orders must not be cancelled during no-submit.
dependency_rule: The causal route adapter consumes refreshed Phase60, Phase66 governance, trend, ETF panel and raw prices directly. It must not rebuild or consume synthetic Phase67/legacy Phase68 same-day performance dependencies.
